entities.summary: Anatoly Nikontsev is a Russian professional ice hockey winger who currently plays for Sokol Krasnoyarsk of the Supreme Hockey League (VHL). In 2010, he won the Cherepanov Memorial Trophy, awarded to the rookie of the year in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL).
